mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening supply-side economy that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 1pp increase over the past 3 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by > 1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a looming economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where the yield curve inverts.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment, defined as a 200k drop in PAYEMS over the past month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by > 200k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer sentiment, as measured by the Michigan survey, signals a weakening consumer outlook that will pressure retail sales and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of months where UMCSENT declines by > 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in input costs, as measured by the PPI for finished goods, signals rising inflationary pressures that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where PPIFGS rises by > 1pp in 3 months.
